projectDescription: A Nuxt 3 authentication module that provides pluggable strategies (local, cookie, OAuth2, OpenID Connect, refresh token) with SSR support, multiple storage backends, and a useAuth() composable.
keyFeatures: Nuxt 3 native authentication module (Nuxt 3 only, no legacy support)
Multiple built-in schemes: local token, cookie, refresh token, OAuth2, OpenID Connect, Auth0
Eight pre-configured providers: Auth0, GitHub, Google, Facebook, Discord, Laravel Sanctum, Laravel Passport, Laravel JWT
SSR-aware storage using cookies, localStorage, sessionStorage, Pinia, or Nuxt useState
useAuth() composable for accessing $auth in components and composables
Automatic route middleware with per-page auth meta support (auth: false, auth: 'guest')
Token validation interval with automatic refresh on expiry
PKCE code challenge support for OAuth2/OpenID Connect
i18n locale-aware redirect paths via @nuxtjs/i18n integration
resetOnError and resetOnResponseError hooks for custom error handling
TypeScript-first with full type augmentation for NuxtApp, RouteMeta, and NuxtConfig
publicApiSurface: $auth.login(...args) — trigger login on the active strategy
$auth.logout(...args) — trigger logout on the active strategy
$auth.setUserToken(token, refreshToken?) — manually set tokens and fetch user
$auth.redirect(name, route?, router?) — perform an auth redirect
$auth.hasScope(scope) — check if user has a given scope
$auth.request(endpoint, defaults?) — make an authenticated HTTP request
$auth.requestWith(endpoint?, defaults?) — make a request with token header injected
RefreshScheme — extends LocalScheme with refresh token support
Oauth2Scheme — full OAuth2 / Authorization Code / Implicit flow scheme
OpenIDConnectScheme — extends Oauth2Scheme with ID token and OIDC discovery
laravelSanctum() — Laravel Sanctum cookie provider factory
laravelPassport() — Laravel Passport OAuth2 provider factory
laravelJWT() — Laravel JWT local scheme provider factory
UserInfo interface — extendable via declaration merging
